title: Signalka: room security by sound, no cameras
lead: Guards a room by sound, with no cameras: a sound louder than the background sends a message with a recording, then a siren. It also guards the PC and detects jamming. Runs locally, no cloud.
problem: Guard a room or a workplace when you are away, without cameras and without a cloud service: the system listens, tells you at once and sounds a siren.
built: Guard by sound through a microphone, no cameras: press "I'm leaving", 60 seconds later the room is armed.
A sound louder than the background sends a message with a recording, then a siren (an alarm ladder).
Heartbeat: if Signalka goes silent, you get the message "Signalka went silent".
Jamming detection: noise above the threshold for 10 seconds raises a "jamming" alarm; a daily sweep from the speaker must be heard by the microphone.
Runs locally on an always-on PC with a USB microphone and a Bluetooth speaker, with its own cellular modem. No cloud.
PC protection: a siren when the power cable is unplugged or a USB device is inserted; PIN stored with scrypt; 26 automated tests pass.
Next: a microphone array for sound direction and a 3D map of the room, then analysis.

steps: Press "I'm leaving"; after 60 seconds the room is armed.
A sound louder than the background is heard by the microphone.
You get a message with a recording; the siren follows up the alarm ladder.
If Signalka goes silent or the sound is jammed, you are told too.
offer: Setting it up on your PC: microphone, speaker, PIN, alerts, autostart.
Adapting it to you: thresholds, alarm ladder, a settings window, an installer.
